action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy allows modifying items in a pending order to a different available variant of the same product type, after explicit user confirmation of all details, including payment method for price difference.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User confirmed intent to replace the 500ml bottle with a 1000ml black bottle, accepted stainless steel as material if glass was unavailable, confirmed use of existing credit card for price difference, and confirmed no other items to modify.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The assistant verified order status, item availability, user constraints (color and fallback on material), and payment method. All action details and financial effects were presented and confirmed by the user before the write. Only one tool call was made in the turn, and the correct item and payment method were used.
